usedFor: Postmark delivers email, and HubSpot stores the sender through “Create Contact” after “New Inbound Email”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Inbound Email” in Postmark, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: An inbound email becomes a contact, so replies from new people reach your CRM.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email address, and “New Inbound Email” is polling, so a delay is normal.
